title: PRISM — Temporal Meta-Dimension
description: Defines the temporal states across all PRISM layers. Not a standalone layer — this schema governs the temporal structure embedded in every PRISM artifact.

temporal_state.description: baseline = as-is today. transition = an intermediate state during planned change. target = the desired future state.

temporal_header.description: Standard temporal front matter present in every PRISM layer artifact.

as_of.description: ISO 8601 date when baseline artifacts reflect reality, or when target artifacts are expected to be achieved.

label.description: Human-readable label for this temporal snapshot (e.g., 'Baseline Jan 2025', 'Target FY2027 Q2').

supersedes.description: Git tag or artifact label this artifact supersedes.

description: This schema is informational. It documents the temporal conventions embedded in every PRISM artifact rather than validating a standalone file.

temporal_conventions.description: Documents how git semantics map to PRISM temporal states.

baseline_tag_format.description: Git tag pattern for published baselines.

target_tag_format.description: Git tag pattern for published targets.

transition_branch_format.description: Git branch naming convention for transition work.
